verdicts.reason: Both are a shrunken copy of the square design sitting in the middle of an extreme wide banner. Roughly 80% of the canvas is left as empty white on either side. The headline and body copy are tiny and can't be read, and nothing was rearranged to read left to right. A looks slightly worse because its text block seems to have a stray pinkish element (probably the brush stroke) sitting below the body copy. In B the stroke stays under the headline, but B is still unusable.
